title: The hard taxonomy of the Godot course
about: Every element the book may use. Nothing outside this file may appear as a technical element. The form and the fields are defined in functional_text/FUNCTIONAL_TEXT.md; functional_text/check.py verifies it. Built 2026-10-02 from the whole of sketch/sketch.json (25 chapters, as it stood at 10:20). introduced_at is where the sketch teaches an element: a section, N.0 when only chapter N's code_new names it, supplied:N.M for a borrowed part, everyday, or missing when the sketch uses it and never teaches it. Entries are sorted by where they are introduced; ids are stable keys.

entries.def: Contains code; here, attached to a node.
Press Play, at the top right. If Godot asks for a main scene, choose Select Current.
entries.note: Palle's name for it, 2 October 2026; it replaces the concept play (the Play button is a step of it now). F5 runs the project's main scene, which 1.1 makes the base scene; every chapter written so far runs that. Running the open scene alone (F6, Run Current Scene) is not in the course yet: it arrives with the first section that runs a second scene by itself, no earlier than 3.1, where the first scene of the student's own is saved. That section defines 'run the scene' (run_the_scene, missing until then). Its other forms are a call in another tense ('You ran the project.'); the wordings that would describe it again are its synonyms, matched in any case. A synonym that opens with a verb counts only as a call, at the head of its clause or after 'then', 'you', ...; 'a waiting thread will run it' runs a function. 'run the room' and 'run your room' are this while the room is built in the base scene; they move to run the scene if the room becomes a scene of its own. unless: a line about an animation or a clip has its own Play.

entries.note: The steps are admin. Which node, its name and what it holds are the lesson, and stay in the line that calls it: 'Add a `Node3D` named `Here`: a position, nothing else.' A {node} slot holds a node class, an entry whose depends_on reaches node. A call is an instruction to the student: 'code can add a `MeshInstance3D`' and 'add twelve nodes by code' teach add_child and are no call. 'Create a `Node3D`', 'Make a ...' and 'Put a ...' are other wordings of the call (synonym templates): say 'Add a `Node3D`'. + and Ctrl+A count only beside the scene tree or a node, so 'Press + to zoom in' is no step of it. The first step is there because + adds under the selected node: 'Under `Solid`, add a ...' needs Solid selected.

entries.note: Godot's own words (Script editor: File, New Script; the dialog's button is Create). Palle, 2 October 2026: the admin was 'make a new script' and made 'create a new script' a forbidden synonym; swapped back. 2 October 2026: replaces save this script as. Save As copied the open file, so the new file declared the old class_name until its code was typed (Godot: 'Class Field hides a global script class'), and typing the new code into the old file first let a run save over it. A new script starts empty of classes: Godot fills it with its own few lines, which the last step replaces. The file's name follows the call in code style: 'Make a new script `bell.gd`.' The script is then put on the root node by put a script on a node (1.3), or, for a class (4.7, 4.8), made with .new(). 4.7 is its first need: spray_can.gd, the first script that is not the root node's (moved from 18.1 by the chapter 4 writer, as this note foresaw); 18.1 calls it. Save As wordings ('Save the file as `bell2.gd`') describe getting a script under a new name, so they are its synonyms and step phrases: say 'Make a new script'. File is the menu of the Script screen (the Script button at the top); 'Choose Save As to keep the old scene' is no step of this (the cues: script, File, .gd). Student reading of chapter 4: SprayCan.new() in the root node's script shows as an error until spray_can.gd is saved, since Godot learns a class_name when its file is saved; the last step now ends 'then press Ctrl+S'. The editor steps (Script, File, New Script, the name, Create, Ctrl+S) are NOT verified in a live editor: the checker cannot click.
